chunks: Aban narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
Do not eat the eel and do not eat the spleen.

key_terms.أَبَانٌ: Aban, the narrator transmitting this report
key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja'far, Imam Muhammad al-Baqir عليه السلام
key_terms.الطِّحَالَ: the spleen, mentioned as forbidden to eat here
key_terms.الْجِرِّيَّ: al-jirrī; a type of eel mentioned as forbidden to eat here
key_terms.تَأْكُلِ: eat; the act being prohibited here
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ: Muhammad ibn Muslim, a transmitter in the sanad

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about eating al-jirrī and the spleen?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a legal prohibition from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام regarding two things that are not to be eaten: al-jirrī and the spleen. It belongs to the jurisprudential rulings on lawful and unlawful foods in the context of hunting and slaughtering.
